title: Unearthing Zombies
authors: Nirupama Kulkarni; S.K. Ritadhi; Siddharth Vij; Katherine Waldock
eligible_reason: Two common national shocks in India: the 2016 Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (post_ibc) and the RBI 12 February 2018 circular (post_feb12). Main Table 2 regresses loan NPA classification (npa, ln_exp_npa) on zombie (z7) x post_ibc and z7 x post_feb12 with firm-bank, industry-by-quarter and bank-by-quarter FE (Panel A adds borrower covariates). Both events hit all loans at the same date, and the two post interactions are sequential treatments in one regression. Prowess Table 7 uses zombie_ibc and zombie_feb12 with firm and industry-time FE plus controls. Not staggered; CRILC data are confidential and not shipped.
design_notes: Code/crilc_main.do Table 2A lines 447-466, Table 2B (no covariates) lines 514-546, Table 3 size triple differences, Table 4 heterogeneity (bank capital, state ownership); crilc_reallocation.do Table 6A; prowess.do Table 7 lines 418-430.
estimators_reported: reghdfe DiD with two common event dates (firm-bank, industry-time, bank-time FE)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Two sequential national events (IBC 2016, Feb 2018 circular) applying to all loans at once.

specs.exclusion_reason: common treatment dates (not staggered); two treatment regressors (z7_post and z7_ibc); extra bank-time FE; data not shipped
specs.treatment_var: z7_post (zombie x post Feb 2018), z7_ibc (zombie x post IBC)
specs.notes: cols 1-2 (lines 514, 522) enter z7_ibc or z7_post alone, each a single-date DiD

data_access: proprietary (CRILC confidential RBI data under NDA; Prowess licensed from CMIE); not shipped
screener_notes: Data/Note.txt only says to add the data once obtained.
